correctness.rationale: The cone D_j z=z_j-2z_{j+1}+z_{j+2}>=0 has full-row-rank D. Every active face is realized with strict KKT multipliers and positive inactive slack, so the projector's local Jacobians are precisely H_A=I-D_A^T(D_A D_A^T)^(-1)D_A. Global polyhedral piecewise-affinity and translation equivariance reduce the two-input adjacent-variation norm exactly to max_A max_k V(H_A s_k) by the path-step decomposition. Independent rational SymPy active-face enumeration reproduces C_n=1,1,6/5,4/3,7/5,28/19,11/7,11/7,5/3 for n=2..10, with a separately checked n=10 face and finite KKT attainability mechanism. For a face with free endpoints and interior affine line, balanced interior steps give even n>=6 lower bound 2-3/(n-1), odd n>=7 lower bound 2-3/(n-2), hence liminf>=2; this is analytic and proves neither C_n<=2 nor exact C_n above 10.
residual_risks: Exact C_n undetermined above ten, no proof of a universal upper bound two or limiting constant.
